title: Maximum Total Area Occupied by Pistons
summary: Pistons move vertically at unit speed between zero and height, reversing direction at endpoints. Their starting positions and up/down directions are given. The total occupied area at a time is the sum of their positions. Return the largest total area reached by this synchronized motion.
